inbox.text: Your assistant has been watching the under 21s. 10 of them are still improving and the plan is not pointed at them. He wants the week built around the kids.

options.label: Point the week at the kids

inbox.text: Levi Cabral pulled you aside after training. The short version: he wants to start on Saturday.
One of your forwards and one of your keepers got matching tattoos to celebrate a win. Neither remembers deciding this.

academy.preview: The head of youth likes this group. There should be one worth keeping.

pending.text: The bookmakers have you favourite for the sack. Are you worried about your job?

options.label: I am going nowhere
options.line: Defiant, and the room enjoyed it. The people who actually decide did not.

options.label: The board have backed me all the way
options.line: Loyal to a fault. It bought you time upstairs and bored everybody else.

options.label: Judge me in May
options.line: Nobody got a headline out of it, and the squad heard a manager who is not panicking.
